signal: Prove raised $40M led by MassMutual Ventures and Capital One Ventures and launched its unified Identity Platform in April 2026

email.body1:
Christie, saw Prove raised $40M from MassMutual and Capital One Ventures and launched its unified Identity Platform in April.

A raise and launch together usually put more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before they cool, and that is where pipeline leaks. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up on its own, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a signal play for Prove off your hiring and tech-stack data, and accounts showing those signals tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Christie, quick follow-up for Prove.

Post-raise, the enterprise target jumps faster than headcount can. Most teams cannot say how many meetings they need to book to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I will walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Prove needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
Christie, last bit of proof for Prove.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and could not hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Prove's reply rate likely compares to other enterprise identity players. Want to hop on a quick call and I will walk you through it?

Christie, I will stop reaching out on this one, but did not want to leave you empty-handed.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your enterprise motion? I will tailor it to Prove either way.
